node.label: Fatigable weakness of neck muscles
node.definition: A type of weakness of a skeletal muscle in the neck that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.

evidence.snippet: Multiple acyl-CoA dehydrogenase deficiency: Fatigable weakness of neck muscles (frequency HP:0040283) [TAS]
Fatigable weakness of neck muscles — Occasional (29-5%)
